dct_description_sm: The paper has been accepted but still needs to be published.

The dataset comes from field interviews conducted with 53 farmers on Santa Cruz Island, Galapagos to better understand farmers' perspectives on bird ecosystem (dis)services and willingness, motivations, and hesitations to planting native trees on their farms. The data is a mix of quantitative and qualitative questions.
dct_title_s: Galapagos Farmer perspectives on bird ecosystem services and disservices and planting native trees
